interface.name: blair_blur_manager_v1
interface.description: A client marks a region of its surface as background blur instead of compositing it itself: the compositor blurs whatever is behind that region and draws the client's (typically translucent) content on top. The compositor alone controls the blur's strength; the client only supplies the region.

description.summary: request background blur for a surface
remove background blur from a surface
a pending blur request for one surface
restrict blur to this region of the surface; a null region blurs the whole surface
apply the last set_region (or the whole surface, if none was ever set)
destroy this object; does not itself clear the surface's blur, use blair_blur_manager_v1.unset for that
